strings.subtitle: — Kaiwhakangaro kōnae —
strings.dnd_hint: (rānei tōia mai he kōnae ki tēnei matapihi)
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kāore e wātea ana te tō me te tuku. Whakamahia te pātene o raro.
strings.shred_button: W H A K A N G A R O
strings.ssd_warning:
Kia tūpato! I runga i te SSD, kāore te tikanga tuhituhi i runga e whakapūmau ana i te whakangaromanga nā TRIM.
Mā te HDD tēnei hōtaka.
strings.confirm_text:
Ka tuhia te kōnae "{name}" ki runga, ā, ka mukua.

Haere tonu?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
He pokatata tēnei (.lnk). Ko te pokatata anake ka whakangaromia.

Ka noho ora tonu te kōnae e tohungia ana e ia.

Haere tonu?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
He puku whatunga tēnei (\\server\share).
Kāore te tuhirua wāhanga e whakapūmau i te whakangaromanga — tērā pea he whakaahua, he tārua raraunga, he CoW rānei tō te tūmau.

Haere tonu?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
He puku nekehia tēnei (USB / HDD waho).
Tērā pea ka pupuri te kaiwhakahaere i ngā poraka tawhito hei rahui.

Haere tonu?
strings.error_cannot_read:
Kāore e taea te pānui i te kōnae:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  KUA TUHIA TE KŌNAE KI RUNGA, KUA MUKUA
strings.report_limits:
• Kāore ngā rerenga raraunga kē o NTFS (ADS) e whakahaerehia.
• Kāore te pukapuka USN e whakapaingia.
• Ngā tārua atarangi me ngā tukutahi kapua
  (OneDrive, aha atu) kāore e pāngia.
strings.step_delete: Muku mā te hipa i te ipu para
strings.status_full: Kua tuhia katoatia te ihirangi ki runga ki te kore. Kāore e taea te whakahoki — ka kite noa ngā taputapu i te kore.
strings.status_fast: Kua tuhia te mātenga, te hiku me ngā whārangi 4 MB ki runga. Ko te toenga kāore i pāngia, engari nā ngā āputa, kāore e taea e ngā taputapu kaihoko te whakahoki katoa. Mō ngā tuhinga matatapu, whakamahia te aronga KĪ.
strings.status_empty: He kore te kōnae, kāore i hiahiatia te tuhituhi ki runga. Kua mukua.
strings.error_permission: Kāore e taea te uru atu ki te kōnae. Tērā pea kua huakina ki tētahi atu papatono. Katia, ā, whakamātauria anō.
strings.error_not_found: Kāore i kitea te kōnae. Tērā pea kua mukua kētia.
strings.error_is_symlink: He hononga tohu tēnei. Kāore e taea ngā hononga te whakangaro — ka noho ora tonu te kōnae e tohungia ana.
strings.error_reparse: He kōnae tūwāhi tēnei (OneDrive, arā atu rānei). Kei te kapua ōna raraunga, kāore i te puku — kāore he mea hei whakangaro i konei.
strings.error_not_file: Ehara tēnei i te kōnae (he kōpaki, he aha rānei). Tukuna he kōnae.
strings.error_hardlinks: He hononga mārō anō tō tēnei kōnae ({n} katoa). Kāore he mātāmua o ngā hononga mārō — he ōrite ngā ingoa katoa. Ki te whakangaro koe mā te ara o nāianei, ka tuhiruatia ngā raraunga, ā, ka tapahia ki te 32 bytes, engari ka noho uru tonu te toenga mā ētahi atu hononga. Mukua katoatia ngā hononga i te tuatahi.
strings.error_compressed:
Kua pēhitia, kua whakamunatia, kua mokowā rānei te kōnae. Kāore te tuhirua kore e whakapūmau i te whakangaromanga o ngā raraunga tawhito nā te mea he rerekē te tiaki a NTFS i aua mea.

Tangohia te huanga: pāwhiri matau → Ngā Āhuatanga → Aro Atu → tangohia te tohu 'Pēhi' me te 'Whakamuna' rānei. Kātahi ka rere anō i te SHREDDER.
strings.queue_stopping: ⏹ Ka mutu i muri i te kōnae o nāianei...
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Ka whakangaromia {count} kōnae.
Te rahi katoa: {size}.

Tirohia te rārangi i mua i te haere tonu.
Kāore e taea tēnei mahi te whakakore.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Tangohia ngā kōnae {count} katoa i te rārangi?

KĀORE ngā kōnae tonu e pākia — ko te rārangi anake.
strings.hardlink_text:
He hononga mārō anō tō te kōnae "{name}" ({nlink} katoa).

Ka whakangaromia ngā raraunga mō ngā ingoa katoa.
Engari ka noho ngā toenga (32 bytes) ki raro i ētahi atu ingoa i roto i te kōpaki.

Tērā pea me ūkui ā-ringa koe i ēnei toenga.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Hoatu ki ngā hononga mārō katoa i te rārangi
strings.queue_reason_cannot_read: kāore e taea te pānui rahi
